statement: OpenAI publishes a system card or preparedness report for the Astra model on openai.com between 2026-08-28 and 2026-12-31 that names at least one external organization, a government agency or an independent AI safety organization, as having evaluated the Astra model.
resolution: A system card or preparedness report for the Astra model published on openai.com between 2026-08-28 and 2026-12-31 names at least one government agency or independent AI safety organization as an evaluator of the Astra model, checked by 2027-01-07; a document naming no external evaluator resolves false.
failure_condition: No system card or preparedness report for the Astra model naming an external evaluator is published on openai.com between 2026-08-28 and 2026-12-31 by 2027-01-07.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.
